Recitals
This Agreement is made on 2025-10-11 between Northstar Pictures Ltd. (“Licensor”) and Blue Harbor Distribution LLC
(“Licensee”).
Licensor controls the expressly identified rights in the Licensed Subject Matter, and Licensee wishes to exploit those rights
only within the media, territory, period and exclusivity stated in this Agreement.
The parties acknowledge that an audiovisual work, a soundtrack master and other related assets may constitute legally
distinct subject matter. No right is granted by implication.

Article 1 (Definitions)
“Licensed Subject Matter” means only the audiovisual work or related asset identified by title and scope in this Agreement
or an incorporated Schedule.
“Service” means the particular subscription video-on-demand, transactional video-on-demand, linear television, music
streaming or other exploitation mode stated for a grant. This definition does not enlarge an operative grant.
“License Period” means the period stated for an individual grant and is not presumed to be the same as the term of this
Agreement.
“Materials” means the picture, audio, subtitle, still, cue-sheet and metadata elements expressly listed for delivery.

Article 2 (Licensed Subject Matter)
Only subject matter identified by title and asset type in this Agreement or a Schedule is licensed. A season, episode, edit,
soundtrack or other related asset is included only when expressly stated.

Article 3 (Grant of Rights)
For exploitation by subscription video-on-demand (SVOD), the Licensed Subject Matter for this grant is limited to “Signal of
Winter”. It is not automatically merged with any unlisted audiovisual work or related asset.
Licensor grants Licensee the exclusive interactive transmission and making-available right in “Signal of Winter” solely for
exploitation by subscription video-on-demand (SVOD). Every right and mode not expressly granted is reserved to Licensor.
For “Signal of Winter” exploited by subscription video-on-demand (SVOD), the Territory is the United States and the License
Period is from 2026-01-01 through 2028-12-31, inclusive. Exclusivity applies only to the combined right, mode, territory and
period stated here.

Article 4 (Restrictions and Reserved Rights)
Except for technical copies reasonably required to operate an authorised Service, Licensee shall not edit, re-purpose or
supply the Licensed Subject Matter to a third party. Unstated remake, sequel, format, merchandising, theatrical, broadcast
and stand-alone music rights are reserved.
Licensee shall maintain geo-blocking, access controls and rights-management information. On learning of exploitation
outside the grant, Licensee shall promptly stop that use and notify Licensor.

Article 5 (Delivery and Acceptance)
By the agreed delivery date, Licensor shall provide serviceable picture or audio masters, available subtitle or script
materials, approved stills and core metadata by secure transfer.
Licensee shall inspect technical conformity within ten business days and give particularised notice of material defects.
Failure to give timely technical notice does not waive a latent chain-of-title claim.

Article 6 (Credits, Promotion and Quality Control)
Licensee shall display the official title, production credit and principal credits supplied by Licensor in accordance with
reasonable industry practice. Trailer, thumbnail and synopsis use is limited to promotion of the authorised Service.
No edit may materially distort the work or create misleading advertising. Encoding, subtitle synchronisation and aspect-ratio
adjustments are permitted only where they do not alter meaning.

Article 7 (Consideration and Payment)
The consideration is 0 USD; this is a royalty-free grant and no monetary payment is due between the parties.

Article 8 (Statements, Records and Audit)
Licensee shall retain records sufficient to identify the territory, mode, availability period and relevant transactions for three
years after expiry.
Where usage or revenue accounting applies, Licensor may once per year appoint an independent professional to examine
relevant records on reasonable notice, during business hours and subject to confidentiality.

Article 9 (Representations and Warranties)
Each party represents that it is duly organised and has power to enter into and perform this Agreement, and that its
signatory is duly authorised to bind it.
Licensor represents that it controls the express grant. That representation excludes music, trade mark, likeness and third
party materials expressly allocated to Licensee for separate clearance.

Article 10 (Indemnity and Limitation of Liability)
A party shall indemnify the other against direct third-party claims and reasonable costs arising from its breach, wilful
misconduct or gross negligence, provided prompt notice and reasonable cooperation are given.
Except for liability that cannot lawfully be limited, neither party is liable for indirect, special or consequential loss or lost
profits. This exclusion does not apply to payment obligations, confidentiality breaches or infringement liability.

Article 12 (Agreement Term and License Periods)
This Agreement takes effect on the Agreement Date and continues until all License Periods and outstanding accounting
obligations have ended. The agreement term neither replaces nor automatically extends an individual License Period.
Each License Period includes its stated first and last dates. Renewal or additional exploitation is effective only by a
separate written agreement.

Article 14 (Sublicensing, Assignment and Affiliates)
Sublicensing is permitted only where and to the extent stated in the applicable grant. Neither party may assign this
Agreement or a material obligation without prior written consent; use of a technical vendor is not itself an assignment.
Licensee remains responsible for the acts of permitted vendors and affiliates and shall ensure their compliance with the
territory, period, mode and security conditions.

Article 19 (Execution)
The parties, acting through their duly authorised representatives, execute this Agreement after reviewing all of its terms.
